# ProductTally

> ProductTally helps creators and small teams choose software. Read independent SaaS reviews, sourced pricing and practical guides for your next task.

Edited by Evan. Official website: https://producttally.com/. Updated: 2026-11-23.

## Cooperation
Product research and review: USD 99, one-time per product. Scope includes a product detail page and a practical guide adapted for the four published languages. Confirm scope and payment details by email; a payment link is provided by email. Commissioned coverage is identified and editorial conclusions remain independent. [Current scope and pricing](https://producttally.com/pricing/). Contact: support@producttally.com.

- [Single-page SEO & GEO report](https://producttally.com/pricing/#seo-geo-audit): USD 66 per page. ProductTally audits one product detail page or ecommerce listing for search and AI visibility. You receive a prioritized plan with copy you can apply to the page. We email the report within 3 days of confirming the page URL. You pay after receiving it.
- [Custom web and content services](https://producttally.com/pricing/#custom-service): Commission pages, visuals, content and online tools for product launches, campaigns and everyday operations. These are examples; other requests are welcome. Marketing landing page design and production: product launches, campaigns and lead generation., Product visuals and marketing images: product presentations, scene imagery and social assets., Marketing copy and product content: landing pages, product descriptions and campaign copy., Online tools and interactive features: calculators, generators and interactive forms.. Email your goals, references and target date. We’ll confirm the scope, quote and delivery plan.

All services currently accept PayPal only.

ProductTally helps creators and small teams choose software. Read independent SaaS reviews, sourced pricing and practical guides for your next task.

- [About ProductTally](https://producttally.com/)

### See what we publish.
- [What to give away when you sell templates on Payhip](https://producttally.com/blog/payhip/free-template-paid-bundle/): Help readers finish one quote for free, then give them a paid pack to manage deposits, balances, and changes.
- [How to turn a vertical CapCut edit into a horizontal video](https://producttally.com/blog/capcut/reuse-vertical-edits-for-a-horizontal-cut/): Keep the existing timing and replace only shots that need wider source footage or new subtitles.
- [How to check NotebookLM citations against the original PDF](https://producttally.com/blog/gemini-notebook/notebooklm-compare-conflicting-sources-with-citations/): Compare conflicting sources in Gemini Notebook, formerly NotebookLM. Follow citations and check dates, units and scope using two public FCC reports.

ProductTally 帮创作者和小团队选软件。通过独立 SaaS 测评和实用指南，了解工具适合谁、要花多少钱，以及如何开始。

### 看看我们如何介绍产品。
- [用 Payhip 卖模板，免费版该留什么？](https://producttally.com/zh/blog/payhip/free-template-paid-bundle/): 用一张报价表吸引有需求的读者，再把订金、尾款和变更管理做成付费项目包。
- [CapCut 竖屏转横屏：保留剪辑节奏，调整必要镜头](https://producttally.com/zh/blog/capcut/reuse-vertical-edits-for-a-horizontal-cut/): 按三种易出错镜头检查素材、画面重构和字幕，保留已剪好的内容节奏。
- [如何回到 PDF 原文核对 NotebookLM 的引用？](https://producttally.com/zh/blog/gemini-notebook/notebooklm-compare-conflicting-sources-with-citations/): 用 Gemini Notebook（原 NotebookLM）对照两份 FCC 公开报告，回查引用原文、日期、单位和适用范围，解释数字为什么不同。

### Mira cómo presentamos productos.
- [Qué regalar cuando vendes plantillas en Payhip](https://producttally.com/es/blog/payhip/free-template-paid-bundle/): Ayuda a tus lectores a cerrar un presupuesto y ofrece un pack de pago para gestionar anticipos, saldos y cambios.
- [Cómo pasar un montaje de CapCut de vertical a horizontal](https://producttally.com/es/blog/capcut/reuse-vertical-edits-for-a-horizontal-cut/): Conserva la línea de tiempo y cambia solo los planos que requieren material más ancho o subtítulos nuevos.
- [Cómo verificar las citas de NotebookLM en el PDF original](https://producttally.com/es/blog/gemini-notebook/notebooklm-compare-conflicting-sources-with-citations/): Compara fuentes contradictorias en Gemini Notebook, antes NotebookLM. Revisa citas, fechas y unidades con dos informes públicos de la FCC.

### 私たちの製品紹介をご覧ください。
- [Payhipでテンプレートを売るなら、無料版に何を入れる？](https://producttally.com/ja/blog/payhip/free-template-paid-bundle/): 無料の見積表で一件の見積もりを仕上げ、有料版で着手金や残金、変更依頼まで管理できるようにします。
- [CapCutで縦動画を横動画に：編集を残して構図を調整](https://producttally.com/ja/blog/capcut/reuse-vertical-edits-for-a-horizontal-cut/): タイムラインを残し、元の広い素材や字幕の配置が必要なカットだけ編集し直します。
- [NotebookLMの引用をPDF原文で確認する方法](https://producttally.com/ja/blog/gemini-notebook/notebooklm-compare-conflicting-sources-with-citations/): Gemini Notebook（旧NotebookLM）で食い違う資料を比較。FCCの公開報告書2件を例に、引用元の日付・単位・対象範囲を確かめます。

## Content and sources
- Product profiles explain positioning, supported features, practical uses, plan conditions and official sources.
- Guides connect products to specific tasks; examples of coverage are linked on the homepage.
- SaaS news covers official releases and product changes.
- ProductTally publishes editorial content; it is not the software vendor. Product conditions belong to the linked official sources.
